newsitem.title: CHINA: SFC SUSPENDS TRADE IN HARBOUR RING SHRS.
newsitem.headline: SFC SUSPENDS TRADE IN HARBOUR RING SHRS.

text.p: Trading in shares of Harbour Ring International Holdings Ltd was suspended by the Securities & Futures Commission on Thursday morning, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said.
Harbour Ring, a toys maker, earlier said it had been approached by an independent third party with mainland China backround which expressed an interest in acquiring certain shares of the company.
Although preliminary discussions had been held, no concrete proposal has yet materialised, it said in a statement.
A further announcement would be made once the discussions materialise or were terminated, it added.
The stock closed at HK$0.86, up HK$0.08, or 10 percent, on Wednesday.
